series.desc: Adjusted gender parity index for youth/adult literacy rate (ratio)
original_source: Source: Population Census Data extracted on 26 February 2026.
Source: Demographic and Health Survey (DHS) Data extracted on 26 February 2026.

India DHS 2015-16. A literacy test was administered to women aged 15-49 and to men aged 15-54. The test consisted of an enumerator administered assessment on the ability of the respondent to read a short and simple sentence. Those who could partially or fully read the sentence are considered literate. Data extracted on 26 February 2026.
Source: PFLS 2021-2022 Data extracted on 26 February 2026.
footnotes: Literacy definition: Literate persons are those aged 7 and above who can both read and write with understanding in any language.
Literacy definition: Literacy is defined as the ability to read and write.
Literacy definition: A person who can both read and write a simple message in at least one language with understanding was considered literate

Literacy definition: A person who can both read and write a simple message with understanding in at least one language is to be considered literate. Those who are not able to do so, are to be considered not literate.

series.desc: Youth/adult literacy rate (%)
original_source: Source: Population Census Data extracted on 26 February 2026.
Source: Demographic and Health Survey (DHS) Data extracted on 26 February 2026.

India DHS 2015-16. A literacy test was administered to women aged 15-49 and to men aged 15-54. The test consisted of an enumerator administered assessment on the ability of the respondent to read a short and simple sentence. Those who could partially or fully read the sentence are considered literate. Data extracted on 26 February 2026.
Source: PFLS 2021-2022 Data extracted on 26 February 2026.
footnotes: Literacy definition: Literate persons are those aged 7 and above who can both read and write with understanding in any language.
Literacy definition: Literacy is defined as the ability to read and write.
Literacy definition: A person who can both read and write a simple message in at least one language with understanding was considered literate

Literacy definition: A person who can both read and write a simple message with understanding in at least one language is to be considered literate. Those who are not able to do so, are to be considered not literate.
series.indicator_description: Youth/adult literacy rate
series.target_description: By 2030, ensure that all youth and a substantial proportion of adults, both men and women, achieve literacy and numeracy
